unassigned_nodes.reason: תקון למקרה־לילה (the remedy/tikkun for nocturnal emission) is the causal outcome produced by the ten psalms. Its essential nature — spiritual repair of a blemish — belongs to a different domain than the instrument-of-holiness domain of package 1 (psalms and melodies). No existing package matches this nature, and there is insufficient material in this brief Torah to form a standalone package for it. It remains unassigned.
